errors.description: The Quick Answers bank prints only zero-form expressions such as (x − 2)² + y² − 16 for equation-rewriting items, omitting the equality and requested standard-form relation.

critical_observations: The worked solutions print the correct full equations, but the bank alone cannot grade the requested standard-form equations exactly as written.
artifact_findings: manual rubric (id 12): "Part (c): a correct response says the equation carries squared terms in both letters with the same coefficient, and a parabola has a squared term in one letter only -- so no rearrangement could ever turn this into a parabola. Full credit refers to both squared terms being present and matching; answering that the picture is round, without pointing to the equation, does not use the standard-form reasoning the question is asking for."
grader decision: award full credit only when the response cites matching squared terms in both variables and contrasts that structure with a parabola.
v2 standards check: the blind packet contains no standards-map.md, so curriculum_alignment is capped at 3 rather than awarded 4.
Every rendered page of the worksheet, answer key, and study guide was inspected at normal reading size; every completed-square form, center, radius, and vertex was independently recomputed.
rationale: The official worksheet, worked key, and guide are mathematically correct and acceptance-ready. V2 answer-key quality is capped at 2 because the Quick Answers bank omits the equation relation required by the worksheet's standard-form directions.
